class.name: GradientGaeaMaterial
class.brief_description: A sampled material based on a set of points.
class.description: Maps a [float] value to a [GaeaMaterial] based on [member offsets]. The material at index [code]n[/code] of [member materials] will be used for values between the offset at index [code]n[/code] and the index at [code]n + 1[/code] (or infinity for the last point).

method.name: add_point
method.description: Adds the specified material to the gradient, with the specified offset.

method.name: get_material
method.description: Returns the material at the index [param point].

method.name: get_offset
method.description: Returns the offset at the index [param point].

method.name: get_point_count
method.description: Returns the number of materials in the gradient.

method.name: remove_point
method.description: Removes the material at index [param point].

method.name: sample
method.description: Returns the material specified by [param offset]. If [param offset] is lower than the first point of the gradient's offset, returns [code]null[/code]. If it's higher than the last point of the gradient's offset, returns that point's material.

method.name: set_material
method.description: Sets the material at the index [param point].

method.name: set_offset
method.description: Sets the offset at the index [param point].

members.member: Gradient's materials. [b]Note:[/b] Setting this property updates all materials at once. [b]Note:[/b] The returned array is [i]copied[/i] and any changes to it will not update the original property value.
Gradient's offsets. [b]Note:[/b] Setting this property to an array of a different size than the current array will result in nothing happening.
